title: MATLAB-Based Layerwise Self-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Network in Applications to Multidimensional Coupled Burgers' Equations with High Reynolds Numbers
summary: This paper presents an improved physics-informed neural network for simulating the spatio-temporal solution profile of the multidimensional coupled Burgers' equations with high Reynolds numbers. As time evolves, the sharp shock fronts emerge in the solution, creating significant computational challenges for the conventional mesh-based numerical methods. In particular, numerical methods such as finite differences and finite elements suffer from poor stability and strong mesh dependency when resolving the steep solution gradients.
